# Bot Lock

> Bot Lock helps teams lock down agent and tool access — a free MIT MCP server (identity, vault, audit, policy gates), a free security Check, and the paid Field Kit and Pro playbook. Built by AgentHive Inc.

Bot Lock is part of AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast, Florida. Daniel Graham embeds working AI in real operations, then leaves it running. First Deploy is the product. Consulting is how you buy time in the room. 
## This site
- [Bot Lock](https://bot-lock.netlify.app/): Lock down agent and tool access.
- [About](https://bot-lock.netlify.app/about.html): Who builds Bot Lock.
- [Bot Lock MCP server](https://github.com/PalmCoast/bot-lock/tree/main/mcp): Free, MIT. Local agent identity, vault, audit log, scope checks, kill switch.
